detail.longDescription: Meta is moving its internal communications from Google Chat to Slack because of AI agents. A memo from AI chief Alexandr Wang says Slack is the strongest platform for AI agents. European governments have spent two years moving the other way, onto sovereign suites. Source: The Next Web https:// thenextweb.com/news/meta-slack -ai-agents-europe-sovereign-collaboration-data-act-switching # AIAgents # Meta # Google
